const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/quality/summary-qa/dune-imperium-uprising/2026-11-04-batch-231507/expanded-iteration-21/reader-a.json')
rows = [
('Q01','Shuffle all 4 III cards and place them face down at the bottom; shuffle 9 II and deal 5 face down above; shuffle 3 I and deal 1 face down on top. Return the unused I and II cards to the box unseen.','Setup: face-down Conflict deck; unused cards returned unseen.'),
('Q02','Both player counts start at 0 VP in a three-player game and 1 VP in a four-player game. Each human starts with two Agents on the Leader and the third (Swordmaster) beside the board; three troops in their garrison and nine in supply; and 1 water.','Setup, step 6: Score track on 1 in 4P, otherwise 0; two Agents; three troops; 1 water.'),
('Q03','Yes, you may Reveal while Agents remain, but after Revealing your turns are skipped for the rest of Player Turns. Reveal effects come only from cards still in hand that you reveal, not cards used on Agent turns. At Clean Up, all cards in front of you from both kinds of turns go to your discard pile.','Turn Structure: Agent turns optional; Reveal Cards/Effects/Clean Up.'),
('Q04','No: entry costs must be paid immediately before resolving effects from the destination or played Agent card. One card selects only one Agent icon and sends one Agent. A card with no Agent icons cannot be used for an Agent turn; it may be revealed.','Turn Structure, Agent Turn: pay immediately; one icon/one Agent; no-icon cards only Reveal.'),
('Q05','At a Combat space, deploy all three troops recruited this turn plus up to two from the four already in your garrison, for a maximum of five. At a non-Combat space, normal deployment is not permitted. Recruits come from your supply and enter your garrison before deployment.','Actions—Recruiting & Deploying: recruited troops from supply; Combat space allows current-turn recruits plus up to two garrison units.'),
('Q06','A Spy Agent icon lets you send an Agent to any space connected to an observation post where you currently have your Spy; you do not recall it. Infiltrate recalls a Spy at a connected post to bypass another player’s Agent, not your own. Gather Intelligence recalls a connected Spy to draw a card, chosen immediately after placing your Agent and before any space/card effects. The same Spy cannot pay for both; two different Spies can be used for Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence on the same placement.','Special Rules—Spies: Spy Agent icon, Infiltrate, Gather Intelligence timing and distinct-Spy restriction.'),
('Q07','Strength is 11: two troops = 4, one sandworm = 3, four swords = 4. If the final unit is removed, strength becomes 0. With no unit in the Conflict, you cannot play Combat Intrigue.','Actions—Strength; Phase 3 Combat: at least one unit required.'),
('Q08','Yes. Passing does not bar a later play; the window closes after all players involved pass consecutively. After rewards, troops return to their supply (not garrison), sandworms to the bank, and Combat markers reset to 0.','Phase 3 Combat: may play or pass; consecutive-pass close; cleanup destinations and marker reset.'),
('Q09','In 4P, the two tied for first each take the second reward; the remaining players compete for the third reward. Nobody wins the Conflict, so nobody takes its card. In 3P, the two tied for first each take the second reward and nobody else is rewarded. A zero-strength player receives no reward.','Phase 3 Combat—Resolve Combat and Combat ties: tie for first by player count; 0 strength gets none.'),
('Q10','One or more sandworms double rewards once; two do not quadruple them. Control of a location and battle icons on a won Conflict card do not double. For an optional 3-spice-for-1-VP reward, you may pay another 3 spice to take it again (6 total spice for 2 VP).','Actions—Sandworm Reward Doubling: one-or-more, exclusions, and pay cost a second time.'),
('Q11','After winning and taking the Conflict card face up into your supply, check it against any face-up Conflict or Objective card in your supply. A matching pair must be flipped face down for 1 VP. During Endgame, a wild icon can match any one of the three icons in your supply; flip the pair for 1 VP.','Actions—Battle Icons: mandatory match after taking card; eligible cards; Endgame wild.'),
('Q12','At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP and lose that VP below 2; regain it on reaching 2 again. At 4, gain the printed track bonus, keep it if you fall below 4, and earn it again on returning to 4. The first player to 4 also gains the Alliance and 1 VP, which is retained only while holding it. Tying the current holder does not take the Alliance; rise above them. FAQ also says a holder losing Influence after a tie triggers a transfer to a formerly tied opponent.','Scoring—Faction Influence and FAQ—Alliance loss.'),
('Q13','During Reveal, Persuasion may be spent before, between, or after Reveal effects, including pooled across sources for one card or split across cards. Acquire from the five-card Imperium Row or either Reserve pile; costs are at the top right. The Row refills to five immediately, so its replacement may also be bought if affordable. Acquired cards go face up to your discard pile.','Actions—Acquiring Cards; Reveal Turn effects.'),
('Q14','An unoccupied Maker space gets 1 bank spice at each Makers phase, accumulating with existing bonus spice; visiting it collects all bonus spice. Deep Desert costs 3 water and offers 4 base spice or, with Hooks, two worms; Hagga costs 1 water and offers 2 spice or, with Hooks, one worm. The Shield Wall blocks summoning at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery and Imperial Basin until removed. Worms go directly to your Conflict quadrant, never a garrison; Hooks are retained, not spent, and are not universally required unless the effect says so.','Phase 4 Makers; Actions—Sandworms; Special Rules—Shield Wall; board-space table.'),
('Q15','At Recall, after a round, 10+ VP by any player or an empty Conflict Deck triggers Endgame. Players first may play and resolve Endgame Intrigues, then compare VP. Rulebook tiebreakers are spice, then Solari, water, and garrisoned troops.','Phase 5 Recall; Scoring / Victory Conditions.'),
('Q16','Standard CHOAM starts with two contracts face up and the remaining standard tokens face down in the bank (18 if Shaddam is not chosen; 16 if he is chosen, plus two reserved Sardaukar contracts). Shuffle the four added Intrigues into that deck and four added Imperium cards into that deck. Shaddam is optional. The 10 contrasting-back Rise of Ix contracts stay in the box; they are not part of standard CHOAM.','CHOAM Module—Setup changes; 10 contrasting-back contracts.'),
('Q17','With CHOAM, the icon takes an available public face-up contract into your supply and refills the offer face up from the bank if possible; if no public offer remains, gain 2 Solari. Harvest completes by visiting a Maker space and gaining at least the specified total spice during that turn; Immediate completes when taken; Acquire The Spice Must Flow completes when you next acquire that card.','CHOAM Module—Taking contracts and Completing contracts; Board Space Guide shared contract rule.'),
('Q18','No. If you acquire a contract for the space after already sending your Agent there that turn, it must wait until a future turn because you had to hold it when sending the Agent. On completion, announce it, gain its shown rewards, then flip it face down and leave it in your supply.','CHOAM Module—Completing contracts.'),
('Q19','Use one shared scoring Rival as third competitor. The Rival gets the Ornithopter Objective; First Player is the human whose Objective bears the marker, and alternates only between the humans. Turn order is First Player → Rival → other human. The Rival never Reveals.','Required Rival Rules—Setup; Agent turns; Player Turns.'),
('Q20','For an occupied destination, ignore it and reveal another Hagal card. A Place Spy card does not place an Agent: place a Spy at an empty post of the specified type if possible, otherwise ignore placement; in either case reveal another card and continue the same Agent turn. Ignore normal space costs/effects and apply only Hagal effects. If the deck empties or Reshuffle appears, immediately reshuffle and continue.','Required Rival Rules—Agent turns and Place Spy cards.'),
('Q21','For 3–4 players, shuffle Objectives after removing cards whose 1-3P/4/6P marking does not match, then give each player one random face-up Objective; its First Player marker identifies the first player. Shaddam may be used only with the CHOAM Module, so not without it.','Setup steps 3 and 5; Shaddam setup; scope.'),
('Q22','Bank resources are not limited: make convenient substitutions if Solari, spice, water, or sandworms run out. An empty personal troop supply means you cannot recruit more until troops return there. Gains come from the bank and payments return to it.','Setup step 7; Recruiting & Deploying Units.'),
('Q23','The phases are Round Start, Player Turns, Combat, Makers, Recall. At Round Start reveal a Conflict first, resolve any control defensive troop, then each player draws five cards. If Recall does not trigger Endgame, humans return Agents to Leaders; pass First Player clockwise in 3–4P, or return Rival Agents to supply and pass the marker to the other human in 2P; start the next round.','Turn Structure: five phases; Phase 1 and Phase 5.'),
('Q24','Yes, you may resolve space effects, Agent-box effects, and other effects in any order. But entry requirements and costs must be met before effects resolve, so the visit’s Influence gain cannot satisfy its own entry requirement.','Agent Turn: pay/meet requirements first; effects may be in any order. Board Space Guide.'),
('Q25','No. An arrow cost/effect may be used only once per turn, with the exception of sandworm doubling a Conflict reward. Most card and space effects are mandatory; “may,” optional arrow costs, and the black-X trash icon are optional. Intrigue conditions and costs must be met to play it.','Special Rules—Arrows / paying costs; FAQ—Mandatory effects and costs.'),
('Q26','A Spy icon normally places a Spy from supply on an unoccupied observation post (subject to any specified connected Agent icon type). If you have none in supply, you may first recall one of your Spies for no effect. If the placement effect specifies an Agent icon that must connect to the post, use only such a post or placement is not possible.','Special Rules—Spies & observation posts.'),
('Q27','No: Infiltrate only bypasses another player’s Agent, not your own. A Spy action does not replace the required played card for an Agent turn. You cannot recall two Spies to Gather Intelligence twice on the same placement; you may use two for different effects, one Infiltrate and one Gather Intelligence.','Special Rules—Spies; FAQ—Spies.'),
('Q28','At controlled Arrakeen and Spice Refinery, the controller gets 1 Solari whenever anyone visits; at Imperial Basin the controller gets 1 spice. Winning the named Conflict gives control, placing your marker and replacing an opponent’s. When a revealed Conflict is at a space you already control, deploy one defensive troop from your supply directly to Conflict, without an Agent visit.','Special Rules—Critical Locations & Control; Round Start.'),
('Q29','In a 3P tie for second, each tied player gets the third reward; the Conflict winner keeps first reward and card, with no further rewards. Tied for third get nothing. Three tied for first each get the second reward; nobody wins or takes the card, and no other reward is given even in 4P.','Special Rules—Combat ties and three tied for first.'),
('Q30','In a normal 3P Conflict with three distinct positive strengths, first and second receive their rewards; third receives nothing. This is also true with a two-human game’s Rival, since the Rival counts as the third competitor. The printed third reward in games of 2–3 players is used only for a tie for second.','Phase 3—Resolve Combat: player-count reward ranks.'),
('Q31','Plot Intrigues may be played on your Agent or Reveal turn; Combat Intrigues during Combat only if you have a unit in Conflict; Endgame Intrigues at game end. Keep Intrigues face down, separate from your deck, and reveal only when playing; after resolving, put them face up in the Intrigue discard pile. If the Intrigue deck runs out, shuffle its discard into a new deck.','Special Rules—Intrigue cards; FAQ—Draw timing.'),
('Q32','An ordinary discard is a card of your choice from your hand and cannot be an Intrigue unless specified. The separate trash-an-Intrigue icon trashes one Intrigue of your choice from your hand. Secrets gives you one Intrigue selected at random from each opponent who has at least four Intrigues.','Special Rules—Discarding; Intrigue cards.'),
('Q33','Trash effects may remove cards from your hand, discard pile, or in play. Return ordinary trashed cards to the box; Reserve cards return to their Reserve stack. Trashing is optional unless paying a cost or directed to trash itself. The Spice Must Flow’s acquired VP remains even if the card is later trashed.','Actions—Trashing; FAQ—Victory.'),
('Q34','Acquire-box effects resolve once at the moment you acquire the card. If your deck is empty when you need to draw, shuffle your discard into a new deck and continue. Unused Persuasion is lost at end of Reveal; it cannot carry over.','Special Rules—Acquire box; Actions—Acquiring Cards.'),
('Q35','Cards played on Agent turns and revealed on Reveal remain face up and in play until Clean Up (unless trashed first). Fremen Bond can use one or more other Fremen cards in play; two Bond cards can activate each other regardless of order. They cease to be in play when moved to discard at Clean Up.','Special Rules—In play / Fremen Bond.'),
('Q36','Recall Agent returns one of your other Agents on the board, not the one just sent; it returns to your Leader and may be used on another Agent turn in the same round. A retreated troop goes from Conflict to your garrison. “Retreat any number” includes zero.','Special Rules—Recall Agent icon; Retreat; FAQ—Combat and troops.'),
('Q37','A free-choice gain-two-Influence icon means choose one Faction and gain both there; it cannot be split. An Alliance icon requires holding that Faction’s Alliance token. Any minimum-Influence requirement on a card must also be met.','Special Rules—Influence.'),
('Q38','If the holder loses Influence after being tied with multiple opponents, the former holder chooses which formerly tied opponent receives the Alliance. The old holder loses its 1 VP and the new holder gains 1 VP. If the holder falls to 3 or lower and nobody has 4+, return the token to the board and remove its VP from the holder.','Scoring—Faction Influence; FAQ—Alliance loss.'),
('Q39','A card drawn during Reveal is immediately revealed and used that turn. A card drawn after Reveal is kept for next round, in addition to the next five-card draw. A Plot Intrigue played earlier whose effect applies at Reveal stays face up until then, is used, then discarded.','FAQ—Draw timing.'),
('Q40','No. A “when you win a Conflict” Intrigue cannot be played after tying for first, since nobody wins. If you receive it as a reward for an outright win, you may play it immediately.','FAQ—Combat and troops.'),
('Q41','If VP and all four resource tiebreakers remain tied, the player who most recently took a Reveal turn wins. Scores may exceed the track’s printed 12.','FAQ—Victory.'),
('Q42','No. Complete all contracts held for that same space with the one Agent placement; you must hold them when you send the Agent. Contract effects are another effect of that Agent turn and can resolve in any order with space and Agent-box effects.','FAQ—Contract completion is mandatory.'),
('Q43','Shaddam does not begin with the two set-aside Sardaukar contracts; he may choose one when he acquires a contract. His Signet Ring deployment restriction applies immediately for the whole turn, not just one resolution order or the whole round.','CHOAM Module—Setup changes, Reserved Sardaukar contracts; Shaddam clarifications.'),
('Q44','Feyd’s token starts on the leftmost Training track space; at the rightmost it remains for the rest of the game. Lady Jessica side starts face up, not Reverend Mother Jessica. Reverend Mother Jessica may use her ability on the turn she flips.','Special Rules—Leader clarifications; FAQ.'),
('Q45','Moving from 1 to 3 counts as reaching 2. You can reach 2 again later by losing Influence and moving up to 2 again; moving down through 2 does not count. Clean Up moving Spacing Guild’s Favor from in-play to discard does not trigger its discard ability; only discarding it from hand does.','Leader clarifications—Margot/Irulan and Spacing Guild’s Favor.'),
('Q46','Accept Contract uses Spice Trade, costs nothing, always draws one card, and resolves the contract icon: without CHOAM gain 2 Solari; with CHOAM take/refill a public contract or, if offers are exhausted, gain 2 Solari. It is non-Faction, so no automatic Influence. Dutiful Service uses Emperor, costs nothing, gains 1 Emperor Influence (once total) and resolves that same contract icon.','Board Space Guide—Faction status and shared contract rule/table.'),
('Q47','Arrakeen: City icon, no cost, Combat Yes; visitor recruits one troop and draws a card, controller gains 1 Solari. Fremkit: Fremen icon, no cost, Combat Yes; gain 1 Fremen Influence and draw a card. Research Station: City icon, costs 2 water, Combat Yes; recruit two troops and draw two cards.','Board Space Guide table.'),
('Q48','Deep Desert: Spice Trade, 3 water, base 4 spice or (with Hooks) summon two worms. Hagga Basin: Spice Trade, 1 water, base 2 spice or (with Hooks) summon one worm. Both choices also collect all accumulated bonus spice. Hooks are retained, not spent.','Board Space Guide; Sandworm Reward Doubling; Hooks clarification.'),
('Q49','Both choices require City access and 2+ Fremen Influence, with no resource entry cost. Option one: take Hooks if lacking, recruit one troop, gain 1 water. Option two: gain 1 water and optionally remove the Shield Wall; it gives no troop.','Board Space Guide—Sietch Tabr.'),
('Q50','High Council uses Landsraad, is not a Combat space, and costs 5 Solari each visit. First visit puts your Councilor on an unoccupied seat and gives 2 Persuasion on every Reveal turn for the rest of the game. Later visits give 2 spice, draw an Intrigue, and recruit three troops.','Board Space Guide—High Council.'),
('Q51','Swordmaster costs 8 Solari before anyone gets one, then 6 once anyone has one; each player may take it only once. Take the third Agent from beside the board to your Leader; it is usable this round and for the rest of the game. A Rival gaining it also drops the human cost to 6.','Board Space Guide—Swordmaster; required Rival Rules.'),
('Q52','Imperial Privilege uses Landsraad, requires 2+ Emperor Influence and costs 3 Solari. Effects: may discard an Intrigue to draw one; recall one of your other Agents and draw a card. No automatic Emperor Influence is listed.','Board Space Guide—Imperial Privilege.'),
('Q53','Shipping uses Spice Trade, requires 2+ Guild Influence, costs 3 spice, and gives 5 Solari plus 1 Influence with any one Faction. The free-choice Influence need not be Guild.','Board Space Guide—Shipping.'),
('Q54','Gather Support is Landsraad, non-Combat: choose 0 or 2 Solari; recruit two troops, and if paying 2 also gain 1 water. Spice Refinery is City, Combat: choose 0 or 1 spice; gain 2 Solari, or 4 if you pay 1 spice; its controller separately gets 1 Solari.','Board Space Guide table.'),
('Q55','Heighliner: Spacing Guild, 5 spice, +1 Guild Influence and recruit five; Combat Yes. Desert Tactics: Fremen, 1 water, +1 Fremen Influence, recruit one, optionally trash a card; Combat Yes. Sardaukar: Emperor, 4 spice, +1 Emperor Influence, draw an Intrigue and recruit four; Combat No.','Board Space Guide table.'),
('Q56','Assembly Hall uses Landsraad, no cost, non-Combat: draw an Intrigue and gain 1 Persuasion during your Reveal turn if your Agent is there. Espionage uses Bene Gesserit, costs 1 spice, non-Combat: gain 1 Bene Gesserit Influence, draw a card, place a Spy. Deliver Supplies uses Spacing Guild, no cost, non-Combat: gain 1 Guild Influence and 1 water.','Board Space Guide table.'),
('Q57','False Orders makes affected opponents move their Spy to an empty post not connected to your Agent destination that turn. It may be played even if no enemy Spy is connected there. Litany Against Fear’s red box is ignored during Reveal, or when it gains an Agent icon and is played normally as an Agent card.','FAQ—False Orders; Litany Against Fear.'),
('Q58','Manipulate prevents opponents from acquiring the removed card. You may acquire it by other means but without the 1-Persuasion discount. If it is unacquired by the end of your next Reveal, remove it from the game.','FAQ—Manipulate.'),
('Q60','The Rival starts with four Influence cubes at track bottoms, three troops in garrison and remaining troops in supply, two Agents in supply and Swordmaster beside the board, three Spies and 1 water; score and Combat marker at 0. Shuffle House Hagal near the Rival, retaining the 2P Reshuffle card. Its 10+ VP triggers Endgame at Recall and it can win.','Required Rival Rules—Setup and scoring.'),
('Q61','As soon as its counted supply resources reach its printed Swordmaster value, spend exactly that value: count Solari, spice, Intrigue cards and water, each unit/card as one, including starting water. Mandatory order is Solari, spice, Intrigue, water, using each as much as needed; keep leftovers. The third Agent is usable in the current round.','Required Rival Rules—Swordmaster resource total and spending priority.'),
('Q62','After Swordmaster, each exact set is worth 1 VP: 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigue cards, or 3 water. A mixed total of seven is not a scoring set.','Required Rival Rules—After Swordmaster.'),
('Q63','Rival chooses the Faction with least Influence; ties go to the leftmost priority icon. It gains VP for reaching 2 and Alliance VP like a human, but gets no resource track bonus for reaching 4. A numbered Hagal Influence icon refers to that position in its Faction priority list.','Required Rival Rules—Rival effects and Combat.'),
('Q64','No. On a two-destination card, use only the destination selected by current condition (Guild Influence for Accept Contract/Shipping; Conflict tier for Deliver Supplies/Heighliner). If it is occupied, reveal another card and do not use the other destination.','Required Rival Rules—Agent turns.'),
('Q65','Yes. At every Combat space it deploys up to two available garrison troops even if the card recruits none. Newly recruited troops at a noncombat space go to garrison. A missing 2+ Influence bonus does not prevent placing the Agent; apply only eligible Hagal effect.','Required Rival Rules—Agent turns.'),
('Q66','Without specified post type, it uses the first available Faction observation post in priority order; if all four are occupied, ignore placement. Placing its third and final supply Spy immediately recalls its other two Spies and triggers Scheme. Rival never recalls Spies to Infiltrate or Gather Intelligence.','Required Rival Rules—Spies and Schemes.'),
('Q67','Scheme-recruited troops before placement can deploy if the Rival visits a Combat space that same turn. If a Place Spy card finds no legal post, ignore placement but reveal another Hagal card and continue the Agent turn.','Required Rival Rules—Spies and Schemes; Place Spy cards.'),
